about.ja: 回帰テストの件数の実測。収集は環境(optional backend の有無)で変わり 40 秒ほどかかるので、regen_all --check では数えず、版ごとに測ってここに記録する。tests/test_trust_block.py が version を pyproject と照合するので、版を上げたら測り直すまで門が落ちる。
about.en: Measured regression-test count. Collection depends on the environment (which optional backends are installed) and takes about 40 s, so regen_all --check does not run it; it is measured per version and recorded here. tests/test_trust_block.py checks version against pyproject, so a version bump fails the gate until this is re-measured.
